newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks close higher, end lingering bear mood.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks close higher, end lingering bear mood.

text.p: Dhaka stocks closed higher as small investors made fresh commitments, ending a lingering bearishness, brokers said.

The Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) all-share price index closed 18.44 points or 0.7 percent up at 2637.84. Of 101 issues traded, 54 gained, 46 lost and one was unchanged. Small investors, boosted by support from institutions, returned to the market. The investors, protesting against a government move to squeeze credit, forced the DSE to shut down on Sunday and Monday.
Ashraf Textile lost two taka to 51, Monno Fabrics gained 11 to 243 and Eastern Housing was up 13 to 276.
